summary.headline: Horary Questions 551–570
summary.text: Catalog of horary-astrological questions 551–570, covering royal favor, letters, inheritances, love, runaways, migration, winds, lunar configurations, money, requests, kingship, military expeditions, deceit, weather, timing, and identifying the question, with cross-references to Venetian and Florentine codices.
